ios.desc:
Tired of missing key points in meetings or rushing to write down every word? Gist is your intelligent AI voice recorder, transcriber, and study assistant - all in one app. Capture conversations, import files, or paste YouTube links to generate transcripts, summaries, and study materials instantly.

Built for Professionals & Students - Powered by Advanced AI

Whether you are in a Zoom call, a lecture hall, or analyzing a YouTube video, Gist helps you focus by recording, transcribing, and summarizing your content in real time. No more typing, no more stress.

Key Features

Powerful Recording & Import Capture high-quality audio from face-to-face meetings, or import existing audio files and voice memos from your device.

YouTube to Note Paste a video link and get the full transcript and summary without watching the whole video. Perfect for research and learning.

AI-Powered Summaries Skip the clutter - get concise meeting minutes, key takeaways, and action items generated automatically.

Study Smarter with Flashcards & Quizzes Turn any lecture or long recording into a set of flashcards or a quiz instantly. The ultimate tool for exam preparation and retention.

Chat with Your Notes Ask "What was the budget mentioned?" or "List the deadlines" and get instant answers based specifically on your transcript.

Automated Meeting Bots Connect your calendar to automatically record and transcribe your Zoom and Google Meet calls without lifting a finger.

Multilingual Support Transcribe audio and translate summaries in over 100 languages.

Perfect for:

Professionals & Executives Turn meetings into actionable summaries and track decisions automatically.

Students & Educators Record lectures and instantly generate study guides, quizzes, and flashcards.

Journalists & Creators Transcribe interviews, podcasts, or YouTube content in seconds.

Stay Secure & Private

Your privacy is our priority. Audio files sent for processing are permanently deleted from our servers within 24 hours. Your notes and transcripts are stored locally on your device or personal iCloud. Gist is the private AI assistant your workday has been missing.

Capture. Transcribe. Study. All in One App.

Stop juggling tools and start capturing everything with Gist: AI Meeting Note Taker. Download now and upgrade your work with powerful, searchable meeting notes and live transcriptions.

Information about subscription auto-renewal:

Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 h

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built an AI Voice note taker transcriber

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I have been building mobile apps for about 8 years now. I built a tool iOS app to just transcribe and summarize audio recordings, meetings, lectures, seminars, doctor appointments, project showcase, event, journalism etc. It can unlimited record and transcribe, summarize and get key data, AI chat with transcription, youtube video to transcript and summary.

The goal was to make something completely frictionless. There is no login required. You just open it and start recording, or paste a YouTube link to get the full transcript and AI summary instantly without having to watch the video.

Under the hood, I am using the Gemini API with a custom model for the heavy lifting. The audio is kept on your device, sent to the API for processing, and then deleted within 24 hours. It is definetly not used for training any models.

Main features:

Audio recording and file import

YouTube video to notes and summaries

Chat directly with your transcripts to find specific info

Supports over 100 languages

Unlimited recording hours (I am trying to make the math work on a flat subscription rather than charging users per minute)

Flash Cards and quiz based on transcript for learners.

Since I just launched it a few days ago, I am really looking for feedbacks. Free generation and free trial is also available.
Thanks.
